| description = 

A small red dragon-like creature.  They are social and will help each other in combat.

These drakes tend to be quite rich with vendor trash items and are an excellent source of early-game money. Most mobs in the zone aren't KOS and there aren't any high level mobs roaming the zone one-shotting you (a la Griffons in Commonlands).

There are multiple conveniently-located vendors in zone on [[Beta_Neutral_(Faction)|Beta Neutral]] faction as well as [[Tisiana]] at the druid rings who is indifferent to all players.

<ul>
<li>''Note: Be advised that [[Tizina]] at the Beta Neutral camp is KOS to some race/deity combinations and is level 30. She should be considered from a safe distance before approaching, especially if you are an Evil character.''
</ul>
